decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the additional office space is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The roof area shall not be used for anything other than the accommodation of plant, and no plant or plant housing shall project above the topmost part of the angled mesh panels shown on the approved elevations.

Condition : 5 - The proposed erection of two additional storeys to the existing office building, would be acceptable having due regard for the site's characteristics, and would provide a sustainable additional employment use within Hounslow Town Centre. The proposal would be compatible with the appearance of the building and the character of area, and would not result in unacceptable harm to the amenities of the adjoining properties, or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal accords with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.1 (Location of New Employment Development) E.1.2 (Locations for Business (B1) Use), E.2.1 Environmental Criteria) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
description: Erection of an additional two storeys to office building
